new_today_news.headline: New SAF technology could reduce reliance on vegetable oils
new_today_news.summary: US-based Aether Fuels has demonstrated production of sustainable aviation fuel from renewable natural gas and industrial CO₂, meeting ASTM D7566 specifications. The technology uses biomethane including landfill-derived gas with captured carbon dioxide, enabling SAF production without relying on vegetable oils, used cooking oil or animal fats.

new_today_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Upgraded to Strong-Buy at Jefferies Financial Group
new_today_news.summary: Jefferies Financial Group upgraded Darling Ingredients to strong-buy rating. The stock carries a consensus Moderate Buy rating with average price target of $69.91.

new_today_news.headline: SustainabilityOnline: The Sustainability Brief – 30 September 2026
new_today_news.summary: Sodexo and the UK Government partnership prevented over one million meals from waste over five years through food donation programs across government and energy sites. The initiative redirects surplus food rather than disposing of it, forming part of Sodexo's wider work to reduce food waste.

new_today_news.headline: Alternative fuel solutions for decarbonizing aviation
new_today_news.summary: IATA reports only 2.4 million tonnes of SAF expected in 2026, representing 0.8% of aviation fuel demand. The article highlights SAF's slow progress and discusses transitional alternatives including co-processing and low-carbon aviation fuel.

recent_news.headline: UBS Reiterates Buy Rating on Darling Ingredients with $88 Price Target
recent_news.summary: UBS reiterated Buy rating on Darling Ingredients with $88.00 price target. Stock has gained 91% over past year and 70% year-to-date, currently trading at $61.13.

recent_news.headline: Grease Trap Overflows in Los Angeles Restaurants: Causes, Warning Signs, Risks and Prevention
recent_news.summary: Los Angeles restaurants face operational challenges managing grease trap maintenance under LA Municipal Code Section 64.30 FOG Control Program. Licensed commercial grease trap pumping experts are essential for compliance, with regular service needed to prevent overflows and sewer blockages.

recent_news.headline: Los Angeles Restaurants Face Growing Grease Trap & Interceptor Maintenance Challenges
recent_news.summary: LA County Public Works operates an Industrial Waste FOG Program requiring pretreatment systems to prevent sewer blockages. Licensed commercial pumping experts identify excessive buildup, damaged components, and difficult access issues that require professional grease trap servicing.

recent_news.headline: FOG (Fat, Oil & Grease) Removal Equipment Market to Grow at 5.1% CAGR Through 2033
recent_news.summary: Industry analysis shows FOG removal equipment market growth driven by expansion in foodservice, municipal wastewater infrastructure investment, and stringent environmental standards. Commercial establishments are adopting dedicated grease-management equipment, with adoption expected to increase across emerging economies.

backfill_news.headline: EPA Updates Wasted Food Scale and Excess Food Opportunities Map
backfill_news.summary: EPA posted new version (3.1) of the Excess Food Opportunities Map showing over 960,000 potential excess food generators and nearly 15,000 potential recipients in industrial, commercial, and institutional sectors. Updated recommendations emphasize preventing food waste as the best option.
